annotations.title: Request on-site photo or video proof

description: Request that a human captures timestamped, geolocated photos or video of a place or object and answers a checklist. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 39 per location in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

questions.description: Optional: yes/no or short questions to answer on site.

what_to_capture.description: What exactly should be photographed or filmed (checklist).
